title: Response evidence binding closed outcome interface
scope: interface/type declarations only; runtime and wiring implementations untouched

checks.name: each evidence binding is an explicit same-source/different-source ADT
complete source-binding receipt requires a non-empty tuple
rejected source-binding receipt requires at least one different-source entry and preserves remaining entries
receipt declares exact evidence coverage with no omissions or duplicates
authority result is indexed by the exact input binding outcome
rejected evidence binding has a dedicated judgment retaining invocation and receipt
controller artifact ADT can carry the evidence-binding rejected judgment for each matching invocation outcome
wiring forwards the artifact-owned response judgment without rebuilding or intersecting another classification
response source identity remains owned by the existing semantics interface
public barrel exports the new type-only contract
no relation/foundation replacement layer is introduced
response contract module remains declarations only
